text:
maria: Need a short-lived snapshot of API traces (last 7d) for vuln triage. Who can approve and what's the least-priv access we can grant? Also want exported SIEM events scrubbed for PII.

devon: We have the snapshot-service that can produce a masked S3 object + timeboxed role. It mints a temporary role with session creds and TTL. Prefer masking at generation time rather than post-hoc.

devon: Example request via the internal CLI:
```
/snapshots create --range \"2026-03-10..2026-03-17\" --mask pii --ttl 72h --purpose \"vuln-triage-SEC-7890\"
```
It returns a presigned URL and an ephemeral role arn for downloads.

sam: Couple cautions:
- Ensure the CMK used to encrypt the snapshot is logged (KMS:Encrypt/Decrypt) and the KMS-unwrap events are retained in audit logs.
- SIEM exports: don't pull raw auth tokens or full email addresses out; use field-level scrubbing rules for exported events.

june: RBAC pattern we use: create a scoped entitlement `snapshot.viewer` that includes tenant_id + event_type filters. Approval is 2-step: security lead + oncall. The role created has a condition restricting s3:GetObject to the specific object key and is auto-revoked after TTL.

security-bot: [automated] Snapshot request created: SEC-7890. Waiting approvals from @sec_lead and @oncall. Audit entry created (action=snapshot.request, actor=maria).

maria: I filed SEC-7890 and added the vuln ticket link. Justification: active triage for P0. Tagging @sec_lead.

devon: Typical turnaround is same-day if approvers respond. When approved snapshot-service will:
- create S3 object encrypted with snapshot CMK
- emit KMS audit record showing key ID
- mint short-lived role with 72h session and return presigned URL (72h)

sam: Also recommend running a quick token scrub step before finalizing the object. Regex we use for bearer tokens:
```
/bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9\-_]+\.?/ig
```
Replace matches with `<REDACTED_TOKEN>`.

june: I'll add an OPA gate to ensure masking=pii on any snapshot that includes event_type=auth. Also timebox the role to 48h post-download and add an alert if download occurs outside 08:00-20:00 UTC.

maria: Perfect — thanks. Will wait for approvals and ping if anything urgent. :thumbsup:

security-bot: [automated] SEC-7890 status update: sec_lead APPROVED by @sec_lead at 1717777833. Awaiting oncall.

maria: Oncall approved, download link received. Noting: will delete local copies after analysis and close SEC-7890 when done.

devon: Reminder: file-level audit shows KMS key id and principal used. If you need extended retention for evidence, open a separate legal-hold request (do NOT modify the snapshot TTL here).

maria: Understood — will open legal-hold if necessary. Closing loop here. Thanks everyone.
